title: Independent producer verification report (legacy)
description: Result of the raw librdkafka C verifier's independent Fetch pass over one measured or warmup topic, printed by adapters/librdkafka-c/verifier.c. Consumed by validateVerification in legacy/benchctl/validation.mjs, which requires exact record counts, zero anomalies, EOF on every partition, and valid true. Descriptive documentation of migrated behavior, not a gate.

topic.description: Verified topic; must equal the measured or warmup topic derived from the run identity.

verified_records.description: Records whose identity, sequence, partition, and payload bytes were all exact.

corrupt.description: Records whose payload bytes did not match the expected envelope.

unexpected.description: Records outside the expected sequence range, or out of per-partition order.

eof_partitions.description: Partitions that reached end of log; the sealer requires this to equal the configured partition count.

valid.description: True only when every record verified, with no duplicates, corruption, unexpected records, and EOF on every partition.
